data.name: Deldar
data.gender_notes: Deldar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is brave, a lion, a warrior, a protector. The name Deldar carries the meaning “Brave, Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Persian. Parents who choose Deldar usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to someone who is a protector of the faith, a warrior of God
data.etymology: Deldar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave, Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deldar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: دلدار
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على من يحمل القلب بالمحبة والحنان
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم دلدار مشتق من الجذر اللغوي د-ل-د والذي يدل على معاني الحب والشوق والاهتمام. وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية أن هذا الجذر يرتبط بمعاني الرحمة والمودة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية ليدل على الشخص الذي يحمل قلبا محبا ومتعاطفا.

in_urdu.name: دلدار
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو محبت اور حنان سے بھرا ہوا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: دلدار ایک ایسا نام ہے جو دل کی محبت اور حنان کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ د-ل-د سے ماخوذ ہے، جو محبت، شوق اور دلچسپی کے معنی میں ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام رحمت اور مودت کے صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام ایک پیارے اور متعاطف شخص کی تصویر کشی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: दिलदार
in_hindi.meaning: जो दिल से प्यार और स्नेह करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिलदार नाम का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति दिल से प्यार और स्नेह करता है। यह नाम अरबी जड़ द-ल-द से लिया गया है, जो प्यार, लालसा और रुचि के अर्थों में है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम एक प्रेमी और सहानुभूतिपूर्ण व्यक्ति की विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में भी महत्वपूर्ण है, जहां यह दया और स्नेह के गुणों को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: دلدار
in_pashto.meaning: د زړه د مینې او شفقت څښتن
in_pashto.long_meaning: دلدار نوم داسې سړی ته اشاره کوي چي د زړه څخه مینه او شفقت کوي. دا نوم د عربي ريښې د-ل-د څخه اخستل شوی دی، چي د مینې، شوق او علاقې معنی لري. د افغانستان او پښتونستان په کلتور کې، دا نوم د یو مینه ناک او مهربان شخص انځور کوي. دا نوم په اسلامي روایت کې هم د رحمت او مودت د صفاتو څرګندولو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Deldar
in_english.meaning: One who possesses a loving and compassionate heart
in_english.long_meaning: The name Deldar originates from the Arabic root د-ل-د (d-l-d), which conveys meanings of love, longing, and affection. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person with a merciful and loving heart. It reflects the qualities of compassion, empathy, and kindness. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote someone with a warm and caring personality. The name Deldar is also associated with spiritual significance, embodying the values of love and tenderness emphasized in the Quran.

Deldar, denoting a lion or a warrior, is a reminder of the strong, unyielding spirit of those who protect their people and uphold righteousness. The name carries a proud and noble connotation, inspiring those with the name to embody the qualities of a valiant and fearless defender.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Deldar reflects the human struggle for inner strength and protection against the hardships of life. The lion, a symbol of bravery and determination in Islamic tradition, represents the power and resilience of the human spirit. It's a reminder of the spiritual warrior within, constantly striving towards growth, self-improvement and overcoming adversities. Those bearing the name Deldar are encouraged to be the guardians of their own spiritual journey, drawing upon their inner fortitude to weather any challenges and transform hardships into opportunities for growth.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun records the name Deldar as a title given to the leader of the Marinids in Morocco during the late 14th century.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun, a renowned historian and scholar, mentions the title 'Deldar' in his book 'The Muqaddimah' as a title held by the Marinid rulers in Morocco.

historical_references.reference: The name Deldar is believed to have originated from the Persian word 'del' meaning 'thunderbolt' and was used as a title of power and reverence for rulers in the Muslim world, particularly in the Levant and North Africa, during the medieval period.
historical_references.context: The name 'Deldar' was adopted by various rulers and dynasties in the Muslim world as a symbol of power and authority, drawing from the Persian influence in the region.
